title: Conservation Agriculture
content: Conservation agriculture emphasizes minimum soil disturbance, permanent soil cover and crop diversification. These principles can support soil protection, water management and ecosystem functions when adapted to local conditions.

title: The State of Food and Agriculture
content: FAO assessments discuss sustainable land and agricultural management, biodiversity, ecosystem services and pressures from land-use change.

title: Global Assessment Report on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services
content: The global assessment documents biodiversity loss drivers including land-use change and identifies habitat-related and ecosystem-level considerations for biodiversity management.

title: Climate Change 2022: Impacts, Adaptation and Vulnerability
content: The IPCC assesses climate impacts and adaptation, including risks to ecosystems under changing temperature and precipitation conditions.

title: Global Biodiversity Outlook
content: Global biodiversity assessments summarize status, pressures and responses relevant to biodiversity conservation and sustainable use.

title: Global Assessment of Soil Pollution
content: The global assessment describes soil pollution as a threat to soil health, food production and ecosystem functions and discusses monitoring and prevention.
